goal: Build the maximum defensible person-level ruler universe before further bulk distillation.
source_priority: polity-specific scholarly/official chronology or primary transmitted tables
MOE/academic Chinese chronology and ruler tables as baseline/cross-check
CBDB/person authority data for identity normalization where covered
secondary ruler lists only as discovery leads, requiring verification

qa_open: Shang 30-person transmitted reigning sequence vs 31 existing packages

Seven Powers plus other entities satisfying same sovereignty rule

batches.scope: Qin, Chu-Han, Western Han, Xin, Gengshi, Eastern Han
Three Kingdoms, Jin, Sixteen Kingdoms and qualifying contemporaries
Northern and Southern Dynasties, Sui, Tang, Wu Zhou, qualifying Sui-Tang and late-Tang rival sovereign regimes
Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms plus qualifying contemporaries

qa: multiple reigns/offices are episodes, not duplicate persons
posthumous title is not a rule episode
regency is encoded separately from sovereign office
every inclusion/exclusion boundary carries a reason
